author: Silver Cymbal
description:
The most useful tool you can own is an adjustable wrench, works on standard & metric fastners of any size. Doesn't leave scratch marks either! So why are people using them wrong? I show you 3 tips to get the most out of your adjustable wrench with the best results every time and to use your crescent wrench correctly every time.
